title: Corporate Spaces at Orbit
desc: At Orbit, we reimagined corporate design — blending professionalism with warmth and creativity. Our team designed key office zones and executive restrooms that balance modern minimalism with comfort and detail. Every texture, tone, and line was curated to create an environment that inspires focus yet feels refined — because even workspaces deserve soul.

title: Joy's Office + Home Space
desc: Joy's space is a seamless fusion of professional efficiency and personal warmth. We designed zones that inspire productivity while ensuring the home areas feel cozy, expressive, and deeply personal. The client has been incredibly inspirational with his design choices — bringing clarity, creativity, and individuality to every detail. Together, we created a space that truly reflects balance, purpose, and personality.
